title: Glowplug's Magical Mod
description: This is an RPG-styled mod, adding several classes and a tool progression
body:
A WiP magic/RPG mod by yours truely. 

(this is the modrinth version. I post regular small drops and bug fixes on curseforge)

Currently I have 5 Classes made, with more planned. 

Mage-

There are 3 kinds of mage:

-poison

-Ice

-Fire



Fighter-

Only have broadsword and round shield added



Cleric - 

Cleric staff and life essence added for yall right now



Summoner -

3 staffs

-Animate book

-animate cobblestone

-animate wood



Arti-fish-er  -

4 weapons:

-Codfire

-Sailfin

-Shotcat

-Sharkzooka
